scripts.docker:build:client: docker build -f docker/client.Dockerfile --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8080/ws -t beatsync-client .
scripts.docker:run: docker rm -f beatsync-server 2>/dev/null || true && docker run --name beatsync-server -p 8080:8080 --env-file apps/server/.env beatsync-server
scripts.docker:run:client: docker rm -f beatsync-client 2>/dev/null || true && docker run --name beatsync-client -p 3000:3000 beatsync-client
scripts.docker:prod: bun run docker:build:server && bun run docker:run
scripts.docker:clean: docker rm -f beatsync-server beatsync-client 2>/dev/null || true && docker system prune -f
